name: Christopher Alexander Whitmore
extra_bullets: Wrote and tested three versions of the flu shot reminder email, and the winning version brought in about 600 more appointment requests than the year before
Organized the monthly content calendar in Asana and kept it current for the store managers, the designer and the regional sales lead
Restocked and faced the produce section before opening each day and kept the weekly shrink log for the department manager to review
cover_letter_paragraph: I also enjoy the less visible parts of the job. I keep our email lists clean, document every campaign so a teammate can pick it up, and check results a week later instead of only on send day. Small habits like these have saved our team hours each month and made our reports easier to trust.
